claims.text: 28 NYC 311 flood-related complaints filed within 200 m of this location in the last 5 years: 16 manhole overflow, 7 sewer backup, 5 street flooding.

Within a 200-meter radius of 200 Water Street, Manhattan, 28 flood-related complaints were filed to NYC 311 over the past five years, comprising 16 manhole overflows, 7 sewer backups, and 5 instances of street flooding.
The location at 200 Water Street, Manhattan, is mapped within the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint as documented by the NYC OEM.
According to FEMA's National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL) FIRM panel 3604970184F, effective since 2007, the address falls within flood zone AE, a Special Flood Hazard Area.
The NYC DEP stormwater model for 2050, accounting for a 2.13-inch per hour rainfall and sea-level rise, indicates that this address is outside the modeled flooding area.
